about.whoTitle: Tejidos outdoor técnicos para prendas funcionales.
paragraphs: YIPAI TEXTILE es fabricante de tejidos outdoor funcionales y socio textil integrado con sede en Suzhou, China.
Colaboramos con marcas outdoor, fabricantes de prendas y compradores internacionales en materiales para esquí, senderismo, chaquetas shell, pantalones outdoor y ropa laboral.

Nuestra oferta incluye construcciones impermeables y transpirables, tejidos elásticos de nailon, opciones resistentes a la abrasión y acabados repelentes al agua sin PFC. Las especificaciones se adaptan a cada aplicación.

context.ski-wear: Ski garments may combine technical shell construction with weather protection, breathability, wind protection and mobility. Share the expected conditions, garment zones and low-temperature use context for fabric selection.
context.hiking: Hiking apparel may need to balance weather protection, moisture vapor movement, abrasion requirements and comfort through sustained movement in changing conditions.
context.outdoor-jackets: Outdoor jackets range from light layers to technical shells. Define the intended layering system, weather exposure, hand feel and construction before selecting a fabric.
context.outdoor-pants: Outdoor pants briefs often consider freedom of movement, recovery, abrasion by wear zone and the level of weather protection required.
context.technical-apparel: Technical apparel requirements depend on garment design and intended use. Share target performance, construction, weight and finishing needs to shape material development.
context.workwear: Workwear fabric requirements vary by job, environment and garment. Share the conditions of use, durability priorities and any applicable evaluation requirements.
